question: Who among the following invented the game of judo?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jigoro Kano**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Judo** was invented by **Jigoro Kano**, a Japanese educator and athlete, in the year **1882**. 
• **Jigoro Kano** established the first Judo school, the **Kodokan Judo Institute**, in **Tokyo, Japan**, to teach and promote this martial art. 
• Judo is a modern martial art and Olympic sport that evolved from ancient Japanese jujutsu techniques, emphasizing **throws, grappling, and submission**. 
• The philosophy of Judo revolves around the principles of **"maximum efficiency with minimum effort"** and **"mutual welfare and benefit."** 
• Judo became an **Olympic sport** in **1964**, further solidifying its status as one of the most globally recognized martial arts disciplines.
